primary_analysis: Retain the predeclared one shared maximin triple across all four bank sizes and the whole eight-seed pool.
sensitivity: Separately at each bank size enumerate all 56 equal-weight triples of the same eight newly trained seeds. Select the triple maximizing the higher of the two matched T1/T2 mean validation accuracies minus the highest of the other five method means on the same triple. Use exact validation counts; break ties by the lexicographically smallest ordered triple.
gate: Freeze all four bank-specific triples before any new-pool test inference. Reuse exactly the 40 fresh Gibbs draws from each planned eight-seed pool model; no new training, evaluation streams or rolling selection.
interpretation: Supplementary bank-specific validation-selected illustration. Triples may differ across bank sizes and do not support a common training-seed comparison.
